title: CateringListResponse
description:
`GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/catering`: the sandbox's catering events, the seeded eight and any
since, by date.

CateringReminder.description: A reminder still to come, and when.

CateringResponse.description:
`GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/catering/{cid}`, and the answer to every catering command: the
inquiry, `quote`, `decline`, `accept`, `cancel`, and staff's `production` and `delivered`.
It mirrors the CateringEvent aggregate's state. A refused step is `409` problem of type
`catering` naming the rule (`out-of-order`, `quote-expired`); an `accept` when the day's two
catering places are taken is `409` `slot-full`.

brief.description: The brief, shown back to its own sandbox only, as text.

deposit_payment.description: The deposit's payment ULID, once paid.

invoice.description: The balance invoice's ULID, once issued.

invoice_due.description: The balance invoice's due date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, 7 days after delivery.

refund_deposit.description: Set on a cancellation: whether the deposit goes back.

reminders.description: The reminders still to come, earliest first; empty once the event ends.

updated_at.description: The business time of the latest change.

valid_until.description:
When the quote stops being accepted, a business time: 07:00 on the 14th business day
after the quote.

CateringState.description:
A catering event's state (docs/domain.md, "CateringEvent", the diagram). `paid` is passed
through in the same step as `closed`, so a response never shows it today; it is listed
because the diagram has it.

oneOf.description: Accepted, the day held for 15 minutes of business time while the deposit is paid.

ReminderKind.description: A catering reminder: what it is for.

oneOf.description: 3 business days after the quote, while it is still quoted.
2 days before the event, while it is confirmed or in production.
When the balance invoice is 7 days old, while it is unpaid.
